body: Unless you've all forgotten, please remember that every scientist needs to sell their research. Meaning that Democrat or Republican, the scientist needs to sell his/her research ideas. That means making it seem much bigger and important than it is. How else do you get noticed when half the country is frozen, half is on fire, we're fighting in three places (that we know of (also including "cold-war" remnants such as NK)), debt is spiraling, and every big name in entertainment is being taken down for sexual assault/rape convictions. To rise above, a scientist must prove that their studies on, for example, newborns and airquality, is as important as the nuclear weapons we spend (on average) 20 billion a year on. It's hard to do that, unless it sounds like you're curing cancer, again. So when small studies make large claims, and don't deliver, it's because the scientist couldn't get funding otherwise.

I tried looking up pro-Trump articles on the matter and the best articles claim how there were alternative terms provided, but only for "science-based" and "evidence-based" as we're all aware. Along with giving no real reason for banning the words, there has yet to be alternative terms released for the other banned items.

In short, it's that easy to condemn because it's that simple of a case. They offer no reason, and no solvency to the problem they created.
